opening.argument: The presentation frames digital work as a set of career and learning options, beginning with SEO as a “career option” and identifying online selling as a growing opportunity in the digital world. It also directs viewers toward skill development rather than a financial product: “You can learn from there for free. And you can build your expertise in social media management.” The material therefore presents SEO, social media management, and online selling as educational or career-oriented pathways. Although it uses profitability and income-related language, the available evidence identifies no specific investment product, financial scheme, payment, credential, or investment condition required of viewers. Its focus remains on acquiring digital skills and exploring work options.
